name: Meetups
tagline: Finds in-person meetups within a real drive of you, and only shows what is new
description: Tell it where you are and what you are after, founder and AI get-togethers, small-business networking nearby, or a mix, and each week it returns options you could genuinely drive to, drive time included. It skips anything you have already seen, so only genuinely new events show up and a weekly check stays quick.
author: nmtalkss
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
